parsed.text: This packet contains two panels (p0 and p1) of fallible location distributions for red and blue roles on a 4×4 grid. Current estimates (represented time 12 or copied prior records) are: p0 — n0 uniform for both roles; n1 blue peaks at (1,0) and red peaks at (0,2); n2 uniform for both; n3 blue peaks at (1,1) and red peaks at (0,2). p1 — n0 uniform for both; n1 blue peaks at (1,0) and red at (0,2); n2 and n3 uniform for both. Candidate (conditional command) records for commands k0, k1, k2 are conditional estimates, not executed events. Several candidate entries change peaks at n0 and n0/n1 in both panels (examples: p0 k0/k1/k2 place blue peaks at (0,2) and red at (0,0) in n0; p1 k1 spreads blue peaks across { (0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3) } and red across { (0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1) } in n0). Copied prior records are noted where present and are not new estimates.
